dialogues.speaker: Xu Liushi
dialogues.text: You ever hear the name Third-Round Knockout?

dialogues.speaker: Xu Liushi
dialogues.text: That place used to be some no-name watering hole. The specialty there was the wine-fermented sweet rice balls, but they were waxy and soft, and the wine was all there was to the soup...

dialogues.speaker: Xu Liushi
dialogues.text: I was young then, and I'd lost a bet with some folks. I had three bowls in a row... and got so plastered that I fell off the ship and into the sea, right as we were weighing anchor.

dialogues.speaker: Xu Liushi
dialogues.text: That incident gave the pub its name, Third-Round Knockout. It also lost me my job.

dialogues.speaker: Xu Liushi
dialogues.text: No one wanted a sailor too deep into his bottle — only Captain Beidou was willing to give me a chance to turn over a new leaf.

dialogues.speaker: Xu Liushi
dialogues.text: ...And that's how it happened. I hope my story can serve as a lesson to you, traveler.
